 `int` instances with the same value will be treated as the same sender, the same as `str` instances. #83

tavily_sources.content:

[...] I read the error closer and it clearly said it was an issue with OpenSSL, so i ran `pip list` on the working venv and indeed noticed a library called `pyopenssl version 22.0.0` . When I checked the dysfunctional venv i found that `pyopenssl` was indeed installed but was version `22.1.0` . Once I downgraded it to `22.0.0` the problem dissipated. I tested again in a fresh virtual environment to make sure, and sure enough it was the same problem and solution.

Make sure to have the following: [...] At first I had no idea what the problem was and there weren’t any clear clues onlines. I knew that it must be a simple problem since I wasnt having this problem in another virtual environment of mine. If you check my previous post you’ll see that I resolved a separate probelm with this same install by switching from a conda environment to virtualenv.
